buttons.label: Resume pursuit
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'fuse-hopper') actor.resumeTask(); }

buttons.label: Ignite fuse
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'fuse-hopper') actor.ignite(); }

buttons.label: Fire ignition
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'fuse-hopper') actor.receiveDamage(1,null,'fire'); }

buttons.label: Ring bell
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'fuse-hopper') actor.onBellRung({eventId:Date.now()}); }

buttons.label: Stun
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'fuse-hopper') actor.applyStatus('stun',{duration:1}); }

buttons.label: Carry with hero
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'fuse-hopper') actor.beginCarry(objects.getOne('hero')); }

buttons.label: Throw
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'fuse-hopper') actor.launch({velocity:{x:0,y:4,z:4}}); }

buttons.label: Reset bomb
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'fuse-hopper') actor.testReset(); }

buttons.label: Verify all clips

buttons.label: Capture alpha preview

buttons.label: Open door
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'fuse-castle') actor.testEntranceOpenAmount=1; }

buttons.label: Close door
buttons.script: for (const actor of objects) { if (actor.definition?.id === 'fuse-castle') actor.testEntranceOpenAmount=0; }
